The issuer exhibits a solid financial profile with revenue of $1.21 billion, strong operating profitability (EBIT margin of ~21.8%), and a decent equity base ($1.38B equity out of $5.77B total assets). However, elevated leverage (total liabilities of $4.39B resulting in a debt-to-equity ratio above 3.1x) and a modest liquidity squeeze (current ratio of 0.72x) constrain its creditworthiness to the lower end of the investment-grade spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
